photography: Representative photographs are reused; no claim of step-specific photos.
curriculum: Educational subdivisions and route branches, not a qualified manufacturing traveler.
demoScope: Teaching animations derived from exercise models; not a manufacturing digital twin.
narrationScope: Native device speech; two authored core languages; other languages need configured translation and a matching installed voice. Text guidance is always available.
videoScope: A separate public HTTPS player removes academy/ChatGPT authentication from file-mode playback. YouTube, publisher, network and browser restrictions still apply.
researchScope: Discipline-specific research worksheets; not authored manufacturing instructions.
catalogScope: Curated representative topics, not a verified global top-500/top-1000 ranking; includes historical antecedents predating the last century.
projectVisualScope: 99 semiconductor, 100 packaging/photonics and 100 electrical/electronics topics have subject-specific original educational diagrams. Licensed photos are representative, not step-by-step production recordings.
sourceVisibility: User-provided course-material index removed from the released site and offline data.
comparisonScope: Each guided course has authored comparisons and representative map points. Repeated institutions are not distinct fabrication sites.
aiRoutesScope: Browser CPU text; optional native CPU text/vision and server-side Gemini text/image with explicit per-request cloud consent. No weights or private keys bundled.
aiScope: Optional consent-based local CPU generation; models download separately. Cloud accounts require Supabase configuration; local profiles work without it.
billingScope: Hosted owner/demo and offline editions contain complete source; protected Python HTTPS commerce requires operator configuration. No live payment activated.
languageScope: Traditional Chinese and English core; 77 optional machine-translated languages require a configured service. Voice availability depends on the device.
